title: HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Affordable Housing Linkage Fee (AHLF) Expenditure Plan and updated AHLF program…
text:
[Council File 17-0274-S7]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to the Fiscal Year 2025-26 Affordable Housing Linkage Fee (AHLF) Expenditure Plan and updated AHLF program guidelines.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. APPROVE the AHLF Expenditure Plan for the revenue collected from July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026:
a. AHLF Funds to be allocated: $33,215,233.37 as follows: City Administration: 15.0 percent or $4,982,285.01; Rental – Preservation and Rental – New Construction: 85.0 percent or $28,232,948.36.
2. ADOPT the accompanying RESOLUTION, Attachment A of the Housing Department (LAHD) report dated October 29, 2026, attached to the Council file, which includes adoption of the updated AHLF Program Guidelines, Attachment B of the same report.
3. AUTHORIZE the Controller to establish new accounts and increase or decrease the following amounts within the City of Los Angeles Housing Impact Trust Fund No. 59T:
a. Account: 43ED88; Account Name: Rental New Construction and Preservation; Amount:
$28,232,948.
b. Account: 43E904; Account Name: City Admin – Reserve; Amount: $790,086.
c. Account: 43C904; Account Name: City Admin – Reserve; Amount: ($183,796).
d. Account: 43E722; Account Name: Technical Contracts; Amount: $607,201.
e. Account: 43E299; Account Name: Reimbursement of GF Costs; Amount: $565,913.
f. Account: 43E143; Account Name: Housing; Amount: $114,876.
4. AUTHORIZE the Controller to increase appropriation account 001010 - Salaries, General by $114,876 within Fund 100/43.
5. AUTHORIZE the General Manager, LAHD, or designee, to prepare Controller instructions and any necessary technical adjustments consistent with Mayor and City Council actions, subject to the approval of the City Administrative Officer (CAO), and instruct the Controller to implement the instructions.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The LAHD reports that there is no impact to the General Fund. Neither the CAO nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: The Housing Department's expenditure plan for fiscal year 2025-26 Affordable Housing Linkage Fee money, along with updated program guidelines.
